model.scope: Phenomenological positive-energy branch E>0 in specified laboratory frame, no asserted stable relativistic quantum field or superluminal information front. Source and detector coupling not specified; all tests conditional on independently verified detection and common emission.

equations.cold_plasma: t_plasma=L/c*(1-omega_p^2/omega^2)^(-1/2) in homogeneous unmagnetized cold plasma

model.reference_frame: fixed laboratory frame only; no closed-loop signaling or Lorentz-covariant interaction dynamics derived
model.important_degeneracy: At leading order both plasma delay and hypothetical advance scale as E^-2 if E=h*f independently valid. Signs oppose; unknown plasma coefficient absorbs a small negative component. Unknown emission lag and clock offset further degenerate. Exact higher terms differ in restricted homogeneous models, not universally unique.

opera.kind: published instrument measurement, not raw event data
opera.scope: muon neutrino beam under OPERA assumptions only

chime.kind: published derived instrument catalog, not raw waveform
chime.scope: ordinary plasma-dispersion comparator; no carrier mass fit or time-of-flight without emission/DM independent estimate

gwosc.kind: calibrated strain data, known ordinary gravitational-wave timing control, not EM or tachyon
gwosc.rule: Whiten using off-event PSD, bandpass fixed, normalized absolute correlation in fixed window; H1 later than L1 around 7 ms. Accept absolute lag 4–10 ms with signed H1 delay positive, and event correlation greater than median off-window correlation. Diagnostic known positive control, not blind or significance test.

TOPA.scope: native archive_record wraps acquired public source digests, not physical authority

EYE.scope: run existing exact benchmark and source validator in temporary directory; candidate witness set only

RETINA.scope: native dependency-free video self-test only; separate new numerical strain diagnostic adapter; actual native radio/optical RETINA not yet wired

TACHYON.scope: native synthetic causal-memory audit + native source-bound witness interface receives shared measurement packet; no physical data training

checks: velocity monotone and exact inverse TOF
CHIME catalog provenance and row/unique counts
frozen_exam.falsifier: For a specified detected carrier energy and path, reject any parameter whose predicted advance lies outside predeclared calibrated confidence interval; fixed finite parameter range and detection efficiency required. OPERA excludes only neutrino-as-T1 ratio above published 90% speed upper bound. Null detection without known coupling/sensitivity does not reject generic carrier.
frozen_exam.admission: No H4 carrier claim unless model-exclusive detection response calibrated and tested under named alternatives; H5 requires same independently measured UAP event.
frozen_exam.independence: Known public controls by independent institutions; execution after frozen protocol, but no third-party blind holdout or independent custodian. No empirical carrier identification.

limits: No stable underlying interaction theory, no detector coupling or information front demonstrated.
Do not equate gravitational waves, radio photons or neutrinos with tachyons.
No production modifications; all native code read-only checkout; no external repository writes.
No live autonomous inter-repo wake federation; single GitHub Actions orchestration of selected native entrypoints.
